item.title: 49 Crowndale Road, 15th October
item.description:
THIS ZEBRA CROSSING IS DANGEROUS. how many deaths will it take for this to be changed? 1? 2? 3? Whats the number? My mum with stage 4 end of life cancer was extremely close to being hit. We have reported this to the police. If an elderly woman who is slow isn't visible to the driver - then who is??? Why does it take for someone to die to be taken seriously? The original crossing were a much better design. This is nonsense. I am sick and tired of myself and others being close to being hit/ injured/ dying for it to be changed? I can guarantee someone can watch for 10 mins. Even 5 mins and you'll see the near death experiences. God help us all!!!!

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Crowndale Road, Somers Town, Greater London
